topic: The Geometric Essence of Cross Products: From Areas to Transformations

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Vectors and Determinants
lecture_lines: Determinants calculate the signed area of a parallelogram.
In 2D, these vectors span a simple flat plane.
This area is defined by the formula ad minus bc.
animations: Fade in vector A (#FF5733) and vector B (#33FF57).
Display determinant formula |A B| = AxBy - AyBx in center (#FFFFFF) using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] to represent the geometric meaning.
Highlight the cross product area in light blue (#33A1FF) within the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg].

sections.title: Defining the Cross Product: Direction and Magnitude
lecture_lines: The cross product creates a new 3D vector.
Its length equals the parallelogram's area.
animations: Fade in 3D basis vectors i, j, k (#FFFFFF).
Draw a vector P perpendicular to the plane formed by A and B, accompanied by a gesture using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hand.svg].
Label P as the cross product A x B in yellow (#FFFF33).

sections.title: Geometric Intuition: The Parallelogram Expansion
lecture_lines: Varying vectors change the parallelogram's shape.
The cross product length scales with this area.
Wider angles create longer perpendicular vectors.
animations: Show a 2D parallelogram formed by vectors A and B using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg].
Transform the parallelogram [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] to show shearing effects (#FF33A1).
Animate area calculation as the height times base for the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg].

sections.title: Linear Transformations and the Cross Product
lecture_lines: The cross product tracks spatial orientation.
It acts like an exterior algebra wedge product.
Transformations distort the volume's spanned area.
animations: Display a linear transformation matrix acting on basis vectors [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/matrix.svg].
Show how basis vectors define the transformation space (#5733FF).
Illustrate the change in the cross product under transformation.

sections.title: Summary: Why It Matters
lecture_lines: Cross products find normals in computer graphics.
They calculate physical moments in mechanics.
They define orientations within linear algebra.
animations: Show a montage of physical forces using cross products, incorporating a wrench [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/wrench.svg].
Summarize the relation between cross product and orientation, utilizing a gyroscope [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/gyroscope.svg].
Highlight the cross product as a fundamental geometric tool, showcasing its use in crane mechanics [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/crane.svg].
